blocks.value: Imagine receiving ₹100 today. You could spend it immediately on snacks, or you could save it for something bigger that you really want later. Saving is simply choosing tomorrow over today.
Imagine This: A bicycle costs ₹8,000. Instead of asking your parents to buy it immediately, you save ₹500 every month. After several months, you proudly buy it using your own savings.
People save money for many reasons: emergencies, education, travel, buying a house, retirement, or simply to feel financially secure.
Golden Rule: Spend what is left after saving, not save what is left after spending.
